Type: chair
Name: Strathwood Paden All-Weather Wicker Lounge Chair
Colors: Gray
Materials: Rattan
All-weather wicker lounge chair great for outdoor use Woven resin wicker wrapped around powder-coated aluminum frame; cushions/pillow with 100% polyester fabric cover Contemporary style; coordinates with matching Paden wicker table (sold separately) No assembly required; spot clean cushions/pillow; cover/store during inclement weather; imported Measures 33 inches long by 30 inches wide by 24 inches tall; weighs 20 pounds
